name: Porpoise DolphinPS5
description: Native GameCube and Wii emulator for PS5 based on Dolphin. Features a controller-friendly game library with cover art, Vulkan rendering, save states and memory cards, RetroAchievements, per-game settings, Wii MotionPlus through the DualSense gyroscope, FSR 1 upscaling, widescreen options, HD texture packs, cheats and patches, screenshots, SMB/NFS network game libraries and Wii online services including Wiimmfi and WiiLink.
author: elripalda
